fact: The LCA and Bureau of Statistics household survey of 2023 found that 35.1% of individuals in Lesotho had ICT skills, against 58.4% who use the internet.
The LCA strategic plan says the Authority, through its Universal Service Fund projects, contributes to improving digital literacy in unserved and underserved areas.
Information Minister Moorosi said digital ambassadors are deployed across local councils to help rural communities acquire internet access and computer literacy skills.
UNDP says Lesotho's 40 Digital Ambassadors will take Intel's 'AI for Citizens' training into their local areas, building on 40 Digital Skills Learning Labs.

Lesotho's Community Digital Inclusion Model, launched with UNDP and now run through the Universal Service Fund, deploys village digital ambassadors to train citizens in essential digital skills, per the Minister.
